description.value: Bikes and Blades is a bicycle rental shop positioned just seconds from the Stanley Park entrance on Denman Street, offering a broad fleet that includes city bikes, hybrids, e-bikes, mountain bikes, kids' bikes, scooters, and rollerblades. The shop accommodates families with child trailers, tag-alongs, and baby seats, and includes a helmet, lock, and free city map with staff route recommendations in every rental. Its Denman Street location makes it a natural gateway for cyclists exploring Stanley Park and Vancouver's Seawall.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 78m; stands (2 spaces) at 79m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active bicycle rental shop at 718 Denman St, Vancouver, matching OSM tags for phone (604-602-9899) and address; the postal code V6G 2L5 is added from the website to complete the OSM address. The site is entirely rental-focused with no mention of repair services, pumps, or mechanical assistance for cyclists with their own bikes, so both required criteria default to null per absence-of-evidence rule. Bike rentals are strongly confirmed across multiple pages listing a full fleet including e-bikes, kids' bikes, scooters, and family attachments.
concerns: Website Common Questions page is truncated at 'Do you offer guided tou...' — unable to confirm whether guided tours are offered.
Shop appears to be a rental-only operation with no repair services advertised; limited utility for touring cyclists needing mechanical support for their own bikes.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active bicycle rental shop in a high-traffic cycling location at the Stanley Park entrance; clearly useful to touring cyclists and visitors seeking rentals, route advice, and family cycling options.

Bike rentals.detail: Full rental fleet. Rentals by hour, half-day, or full day. Helmet, lock, and free map included
